import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'amount': [115.02, 44.37, 144.25, 536.22, 38.43],
    'is_fraud': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'transaction_type': ['refund', 'payment', 'transfer', 'payment', 'payment'],
    'hour_of_day': [22, 5, 21, 17, 5]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set the visual style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a bar plot for transaction amounts by transaction type
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', y='amount', hue='is_fraud', palette='viridis', ci=None)
plt.title('Transaction Amounts by Type and Fraud Status')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Amount')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='Is Fraud', loc='upper right', labels=['No', 'Yes'])
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png')
